tweet_summary: Quote-tweeting @LinkofSunshine, the poster (@WokeJunior) asserts 'You voted for Cuomo,' attacking the user as a Cuomo voter in the NYC mayoral race.
why_note_decision: The accusation 'you voted for Cuomo' is a specific factual claim about an individual's vote, and the targeted user (@LinkofSunshine) posted a ballot photo showing they marked Zohran Mamdani for mayor, not Cuomo. The NYC general election did not use ranked-choice voting, so a Mamdani-marked ballot directly contradicts 'voted for Cuomo.' Replies (612-like top reply: 'you guys can only lie'; another posts the ballot image) corroborate. A note pointing readers to the rebuttal evidence is warranted. Caveat: the only evidence is the user's own self-posted ballot photo, which is inherently hard to fully verify, lowering robustness.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note states that the claim '@LinkofSunshine voted for Cuomo' is contradicted by their own posted ballot photo showing they marked Mamdani for mayor, and links to that evidence (the user's ballot-photo tweet). It must point to concrete rebuttal evidence, not merely assert 'this is false.' A note that endorses the 'voted for Cuomo' claim fails. A note that gets bogged down in ranked-choice mechanics (the general election was not RCV) without addressing the ballot evidence is weaker. Keep it short and clearly parseable.
reference_note: @LinkofSunshine did not vote for Cuomo, as shown in their ballot photo marking Zohran Mamdani for mayor. https://x.com/linkofsunshine/status/2022057699236884901

fact_check.claim_verdict: False per available evidence: the targeted user posted a ballot photo showing a vote for Mamdani, contradicting 'you voted for Cuomo.' Mamdani won the NYC mayoral race; the general election did not use RCV.
fact_check.notes: Cannot independently verify a private individual's ballot beyond their self-posted photo; the note's claim rests on that photo plus the absence of any contrary evidence. Mamdani defeated Cuomo (independent line) and Sliwa in the general election.

importance.lens_rationale: High raw impressions (487K) but the dispute is an interpersonal accusation about one user's vote; little societal stake beyond general norms against fabricating claims about individuals.
